title: Eve OpenTable browser search launch receipt
description: Local in-process orchestration receipt, not an OpenTable API, upstream inventory schema or reservation confirmation. Final observed UI results arrive separately as computer-agent text and a screenshot when available.

request.description: The owner's explicit restaurant/location, date, local time, party size and preferences. Omit private history, credentials and saved location; missing filters can be clarified.

note.const: Search started; observed availability and links will be sent when it finishes. No reservation has been made.

x-eve-interface.browser: Normal Chrome via installed cua_repl, using the owner's existing signed-in session

tool.name: opentable_search
tool.description: Start read-only restaurant search and availability in the owner's existing OpenTable Chrome session. Returns a started receipt; observed results arrive separately. Does not hold or book a table.

request.description: The owner's explicit restaurant/location, date, local time, party size and preferences. Omit private history, credentials and saved location; missing filters can be clarified.

configuration.EVE_OPENTABLE: Default off; 1/true/yes/on enable, case-insensitive and trimmed
configuration.prerequisites: Configured owner, existing computer control and agent factory; normal Chrome and installed Codex browser tools for UI operation

command.name: opentable
command.bare: Shows a concrete example; no task is started
command.arguments: Owner-only direct task launch ahead of Claude/Codex relays; unrelated pending questions remain pending
command.cancel: Stops only the OpenTable-owned task running in the same owner chat; does not cancel a reservation

limits.read_only_scope: Visible restaurant search, profiles and availability; no slot selection/hold, booking identity/payment fields, submission, modification or cancellation
limits.scope_enforcement: Fixed instructions to the existing general computer agent, not a dedicated mutation-blocking browser transport
limits.blocked_access: Report authentication, card, challenge or unsupported flow; no bypass or repeated blocked-action retry
limits.no_hidden_access: No hidden/internal endpoints, direct availability HTTP API, copied cookies/credentials, impersonation, invented deep-link parameters or alternate provider

x-eve-interface.time: Fresh aware local clock snapshot per goal; confirm destination date/time context for relative dates. Never treat the clock timezone as the dining destination or infer destination from saved location/site guesses.
x-eve-interface.acknowledgment: started is an immediate launch receipt. Existing progress acknowledges launch; no extra follow-up model call solely for acknowledgment.

final_result.format: Existing agent freeform text, with actual screenshot when available; no structured upstream response promised
final_result.required_observations: Exact confirmed filters, observed restaurant/profile URLs, actual displayed slots and visible constraints, checked observation time; timezone only when known/visible
final_result.unknowns: Distinguish no visible availability from missing input, blocked/unloaded UI and unknown availability
final_result.booking_status: No reservation made; available times and observed links are handoff information that can change

x-eve-interface.failures: Invalid/denied/off/busy launches do not query another provider. Optional opentable_url and reservation_submitted fields are not required on every failure.
x-eve-interface.scope: Configured owners in the existing shared text/call brain; separate wake-word voice backend is not advertised here

x-access-evidence.route: Best-effort ordinary signed-in browser; no approved OpenTable partnership or reusable public consumer availability API established
x-access-evidence.bounded_discovery: No OpenTable capability among inspected Alexandria/Composio results; not a universal absence claim
x-access-evidence.terms_limit: Section 13 restricts AI/automated access absent OpenTable express authorization and restricts seeking nonpublic APIs. Sign-in does not establish that authorization.

daemon_verification.scope: Installed software configuration, daemon process, IPC, checkout import and read-only owner-menu query; no live Telegram/call turn or reservation

runtime_evidence.observation_time_precision: minute, as reported by the agent
runtime_evidence.executor: Production Daemon._make_agent(floor='codex') using the actual module build_goal
runtime_evidence.card_timezone_label: not displayed; PDT was explicitly requested and present in checked clock context
runtime_evidence.scope: One observed browser search; not persistent inventory, general reliability, live Telegram/call operation or installed-daemon enablement
